newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain CPI may be under 2pct in next months-Montoro.
newsitem.headline: Spain CPI may be under 2pct in next months-Montoro.

text.p: Spanish Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Wednesday inflation is likely to continue improving in the coming months, and might dip below two percent.

Speaking in an interview on national radio, Montoro said, "Inflation has moderated a lot...and will continue to perform well in the coming months so that we get near to two percent or even perhaps moving below two percent in the next few months."
March inflation was at 2.2 percent year on year, down from 2.5 percent in February and 2.9 percent in January.
Economists forecast that the CPI may dip below the two percent level in April or May.
Montoro added that expected economic growth should fuel job creation.

"Thanks to inflation control and the good state of our accounts -- which are really healthy -- we are facing an economic recovery on a very healthy and solid base, and we can affirm that we are going to see a period of economic recovery in Spain which can and should be sufficiently long to produce substantial employment creation," he said.
Montoro added that the current economic climate in Spain has never been so good.

"Spain has never met such a number of important objective conditions (low inflation, interest rates...), and definitively everything is providing the basis for conditions which will stimulate investment and which will become the protagonist of our economic growth," he added.
